themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across multiple countries are organizing major campaign launches, national congresses, and strategic electoral pacts—such as Vox and PP joining forces in Spain, and Marine Le Pen launching her presidential bid in France—amid surging poll numbers and heightened voter mobilization.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Sealed a strategic Senate pact with the PP to consolidate conservative majorities and campaign aggressively ahead of the November 29 general elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Held its 19th national congress in Orléans where Marine Le Pen officially launched her 2027 presidential campaign, emphasizing public order and sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Hit historic polling highs under Sylvi Listhaug, positioning the party for unprecedented electoral dominance ahead of upcoming local and national cycles.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Unveiled an extensive 'Economic Rescue Plan' and pressed ahead with aggressive campaigning led by Nigel Farage and Robert Jenrick.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Ramped up intense midterm campaign rallies across battleground states like Mississippi and Kansas featuring Donald Trump and JD Vance.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's victory in the Brazilian presidential runoff, the fallout continues as authorities probe alleged foreign interference and passport restrictions, while parts of the right-wing establishment grapple with concessions, denial rumors, and international implications.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Facing intense legal scrutiny after the TSE confirmed defeat, including passport seizures for Flávio Bolsonaro and federal police probes into alleged escape attempts and foreign interference.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faced diplomatic tensions and domestic blowback over delayed or withheld congratulations to Lula, alongside regional economic fallout concerns.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing governing coalitions and nationalist parties are experiencing internal strains, ranging from public ideological feuds over national identity in Sweden and leadership disputes in Italy and Germany to factional maneuvering in Poland and Argentina.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Public feuds erupted between top figures like Mattias Karlsson and Richard Jomshof over the definition of Swedishness, pitting cultural nationalism against ethnonationalism.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Persistent tensions between Matteo Salvini's Lega and coalition allies over budget prudence, foreign policy on Ukraine, and shifting party alignments.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Struggling with fallout from massive internal data leaks exposing campaign funding questions, local factional disputes, and controversies surrounding leadership remarks.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal government friction intensified as figures like Patricia Bullrich publicly broke with President Milei over attacks on journalists and foreign policy stances.

themes.title: US Diplomatic Backing for Viktor Orbán's International Stature
themes.blurb: Transnational right-wing networks and diplomatic channels continue to amplify proposals originating from the US sphere to elevate Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán onto the international stage, sparking intense debate across European capitals.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Domestic media and political actors heavily debated international reports regarding US backing for Viktor Orbán to succeed António Guterres as United Nations Secretary-General.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: US conservative networks and administration-linked proposals advanced international diplomatic maneuvers positioning Orbán for global leadership roles.

themes.title: Populist Energy Policies and Rollbacks of Climate Regulations
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties and populist figures continue to champion anti-green regulatory rollbacks, pushing for fossil fuel expansion, dismantling carbon pricing mechanisms, and criticizing European Union climate frameworks as economically damaging.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Meloni's government called for direct EU intervention to roll back Emissions Trading System (ETS) costs to protect struggling domestic industrial sectors like chemicals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK campaigned heavily on traditional energy exploitation ('Drill, baby, drill') and dismantling net-zero policies as part of their economic rescue plans.
